{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 18 is the 74th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 18th day of Aquarius, and it is a Thursday. It corresponds to ISO week 11, weekday 4.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮18日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 74|Chapter 74]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152094}}.
